text: Hello and welcome to our live coverage of this Premier League fixture as Wolves host Manchester City at Molineux!

Wolves are in need of a result after taking just four points from their first six games of the Premier League season, but they face the most difficult of tasks here! Gary O'Neil has been in charge for just over seven weeks, but last Saturday's draw against Luton Town, which was followed by an EFL Cup defeat at Ipswich Town, has ramped up the pressure on the ex-Bournemouth boss.
Can he mastermind a huge upset at Molineux?

City, meanwhile, have enjoyed a serene start to their latest Premier League title defence, winning their first six games of the campaign, though they did fall to a 1-0 defeat at Newcastle United in the EFL Cup in midweek.

Pep Guardiola's team could become just the third side to begin a Premier League campaign with seven successive victories – both of the previous two went on to win the title, with Chelsea doing so in 2005-06 (first nine) and Liverpool replicating that feat in 2019-20 (first eight).
After rotating for Tuesday's 3-2 cup defeat at Ipswich, O'Neil makes one enforced change to the team that started last week's draw at Luton.
Jean-Ricner Bellegarde serves the second game of his three-match ban after being dismissed at Kenilworth Road, so Toti comes in as Wolves switch to a back three.
Tommy Doyle is ineligible against his parent club, so Hodge takes his spot on the bench.
City are also missing a midfielder through suspension after Rodri saw red in last week's 2-0 win over Nottingham Forest.
Kovacic takes his place in the centre of the park alongside Matheus, who is sure to get a frosty reception on his return to Molineux.
In the only other change to the team which beat Forest, Ake replaces Gvardiol at the back, while a series of injuries leave Guardiola unable to fill his bench.
Having done the Premier League double over City in 2019-20 under Nuno Espirito Santo, Wolves have now lost their last six against the Citizens by an aggregate score of 19-3.
Is another heavy defeat on the cards for the hosts, or might they spring a surprise? Kick-off is fast approaching in the West Midlands!
Wolves get the game under way at Molineux!
Matheus gets an early touch and Molineux erupts with a chorus of jeers.
He will have expected that after refusing to train to force through his deadline-day move to the European champions.
City – donning their white and claret change kit – enjoy an early spell of possession before Akanji tries his luck, flashing an effort over the crossbar from range.
The Wolves fans have not let up in their treatment of Matheus here, with every touch the midfielder takes drawing a fierce reaction from the home crowd.
City have won their last three Premier League away games against Wolves, as many victories as they'd picked up in their previous 12 league visits to Molineux (D2 L7).
Heroic defending from Dawson! Matheus is picked out by Dias' ball over the top and the former Wolves man looks to put it on a plate for Haaland inside the six-yard box.
The Norwegian is stretching to tap home, but Dawson gets across him to make a vital intervention.
Just wide! City threaten again as Doku lines up an effort from the left corner of the box, and it deflects narrowly wide of Sa's left-hand post.
Wolves are on the ropes early on!
Guardiola is in the stands for this game, have accumulated three yellow cards in the season's early weeks.
City coped just fine when back surgery forced their head coach to miss games against Sheffield United and Fulham earlier in the campaign, winning both matches.
Toti's loose pass gifts City possession inside the Wolves half.
O'Neil's men are yet to gain anything resembling a foothold here.
Wolves attack for the first time as Cunha offloads to Ait-Nouri, but his left-wing cross is headed away by Dias.
The hosts come again through Neto, but Matheus gets back to clear this time.
GOOOOOOOOOOAAAAAAAAAALLLLLL! WOLVES LEAD! Dias puts through his own net! Wow! Neto charges down the wing, beating Ake with ease before sending in a low cross from the right.
Dias slides in to make the block and inadvertently diverts the ball past Ederson! 1-0!
Molineux is bouncing now! The hosts have got a huge slice of luck there with Dias putting through his own net, but what a run it was from Neto – his fine start to the campaign continues!
Neto has either scored or assisted in each of Wolves' last four Premier League matches (one goal, four assists in total).
Only two players have been involved in at least one goal in five Premier League appearances in a row for Wolves – Henri Camara (March – May 2004, seven) and Steven Fletcher (May – August 2011, five).
He won't get any credit for that goal, but it came at the end of a magnificent solo run!
'Nunes, what's the score?' is the chant ringing around Molineux as City probe for an opening.
Matheus' appearance as a pantomime villain has really lifted the home crowd.
Walker receives the first yellow card of the game, having pulled Ait-Nouri back to prevent a Wolves break.
Haaland tries to jink his way past two Wolves challenges inside the area, but Toti pokes out a leg to win the ball.
Wolves counter through Neto, but his misplaced pass towards Ait-Nouri allows Walker to win a foul off the Wolves left wing-back.
A big cheer goes up as Matheus is grounded by Gomes, who wins a throw-in for the hosts.
The City midfielder needs to get acclimatised to this rough treatment.
Doku drives inside from the left before bending an effort towards the far post.
There's not enough curl on his finish, however, so Sa can watch it drift behind.
Wolves look content to sit deep in a 5-2-3 shape when City have possession.
Neto clearly fancies himself against Ake, rather than against Walker.
He's started on the right with Hwang on the left.
Hwang chases Sa's long kick downfield before catching Akanji with a high boot.
He becomes the first Wolves player to see yellow.
We're past the 25-minute mark here, and O'Neil will be delighted with Wolves' defensive efforts.
City haven't got going in the final third yet.
They have a free-kick 25-yards out as Gomes trips Matheus.
BIG SAVE! Alvarez lifts the free-kick towards Ake, whose first header towards goal is blocked by Semedo.
It comes back to the City defender, and his second effort is turned away by Sa!
Haaland is able to bring Matheus' pass under his spell on the right side of the Wolves area, but Toti and Ait-Nouri get back to force the Norwegian wide and City have to go backwards.
DANGER! Ait-Nouri is caught in possession by Foden on the edge of the Wolves area.
The City man dances to the byline as Sa comes out to meet him, and the Wolves goalkeeper just turns his attempted cutback behind.
City's resulting corner is cleared, but Doku tries again with a delivery from a deep position on the left.
Haaland is lurking at the far post, but Sa climbs above him to pluck it out of the air.
Wolves' defenders get a breather as Kilman breaks forward before going down under Ake's lunging challenge, winning a free-kick just inside City's half.
City are continuing to penalty Wolves back, but the hosts are getting tight and defending aggressively around the edge of their own area.
Ait-Nouri makes a good sliding challenge to prevent Walker receiving possession high on the right.
Semedo almost breaks in behind from a long ball over the top, but Ake slides in to play the ball off his opponent and out, winning a goal-kick.
Hwang turns away from a white shirt before Cunha feeds the ball out to Neto.
He drives past Ake on the Wolves right, but this time, Dias clears his cross in a composed manner!
City win a free-kick 35 yards out, which Kovacic works out to Doku on the left.
His low delivery is a poor one, however, and Lemina clears it with ease.
Lemina chases Matheus inside the Wolves half before tripping his former midfield partner, picking up a deserved yellow card.
Most of City's attacks have come down their left flank.
Doku steps inside to shoot once again, but his wild effort is always rising and Sa is untroubled.
Neto flicks the ball over Ake's shoulder while keeping a long pass in play on the Wolves right, and the Dutch defender catches his opponent in the face with a trailing arm.
Wolves are given a free-kick and Neto stays down to receive treatment.
Neto is back up and ready to re-enter the action as Wolves get the game under way again.
Dawson wants a foul as he tussles with Walker, but the referee is unmoved.
Neto steals possession from Matheus to get Wolves moving forward.
The winger's cross towards Hwang just lacks the necessary power, however, so the attack breaks down.
We're into the final minute of the opening half.
We will have three minutes of first-half stoppage time.
BIG CHANCE! The home fans hold their breath as Ake finds Matheus unmarked near the edge of the six-yard box, but his glancing header is straight at Sa!
Wolves threaten as Hwang races down the left-hand channel, before cutting inside and seeing his shot blocked by Dias.
Hwang then catches Walker with a late challenge and City's players appeal for the Korean to be shown another yellow card... but Craig Pawson gives him the benefit of the doubt.
CHANCE! City win a late free-kick, which is lifted onto the head of Dias.
The City captain is unmarked, but he heads straight at Sa from 12 yards out!
HALF-TIME: WOLVES 1-0 MANCHESTER CITY.

It's half-time at Molineux, and Manchester City's perfect start to the Premier League season is under threat! They trail Wolves 1-0 courtesy of Dias' early own goal, which was forced by a brilliant solo run from in-form winger Neto.
City have dominated possession and territory since then, but Sa has been relatively comfortable in making saves to deny Ake, Matheus and Dias.
Guardiola will be demanding more from the champions after the break!

Wolves have only managed one shot to City's 13 and are yet to record an attempt on target, but Dias' own goal has given them something to defend! City have only hit the target twice themselves, and they will have to up the tempo of their play to find a way past Wolves' stubborn backline.
Guardiola has made a half-time change, and a huge cheer erupts around Molineux as the home fans realise Matheus has been hooked! Bobb is on for the former Wolves midfielder, who was struggling.
City get the second half under way! Will the champions find a route back at Molineux, as they did at West Ham in their last league outing?
Wolves have made a habit of starting games strongly before running out of stream this season, letting leads slip against Liverpool and Luton in their last two Premier League outings.
They got the crowd up for this match by playing with great intensity in the first 45 minutes – can they keep it up?
City win a corner early in the second half as Kilman heads a dangerous cross behind.
Foden delivers the set-piece, but Dawson rises to head clear.
Bobb then fouls the Wolves defender, giving the hosts a free-kick.
46.3 per cent of the action in the first half came in Wolves' defensive third.
They will certainly have plenty more defending to do in the second half.
Dias tries to make amends for his own goal by letting fly from 30 yards out, but his wild shot rises into the south bank behind Sa's goal!

Ake simply can't cope with Neto! The Portugal international races past his marker on the outside before crossing, but no old gold shirts are there to turn it home as Ederson claims it at his near post.
Bobb finds space between the lines to feed Haaland... but a rare miskick from the Norwegian goal machine bobbles into the grateful gloves of Wolves goalkeeper Sa!
Wolves are not happy as Pawson pulls play back for Doku's foul on Hwang, with Ait-Nouri feeling the advantage was with him as he looked to break through the heart of midfield.
Cunha stays down following a clumsy challenge from Dias, but the referee waves play on as City look to break... only for Alvarez to lift a tame 20-yard effort straight into the hands of Sa.
Wolves' fans are absolutely furious as Cunha drives forward brilliantly, carrying the ball 40 yards and beating Kovacic with ease before going down under Dias' challenge.
The Brazilian wants a free-kick, but Pawson shakes his head.
Now City break up the other end and win a free-kick as Bobb is fouled by Gomes on the edge of the box.
Gomes avoids a booking, but Neto sees yellow for his protests.
GOOOOOOAAAAAAAAALLLLLL! ALVAREZ LEVELS WITH A GREAT STRIKE! Alvarez lines up the free-kick from a position just to left of the D.
With Sa slightly too far to his left, the Argentina forward whips an effort into the near top corner! It's 1-1 at Molineux!
Now Kovacic goes into the book for a wild lunge on Gomes.
This has been a feisty affair from the first whistle.
The home fans were unhappy to see Cunha denied a free-kick at one end shortly before Bobb was awarded one at the other end.
Alvarez made no mistake from the dead-ball situation, and this game is finely poised as we pass the hour mark.
Guardiola has his earphones in as he relays instructions down to the dugout from his position in the directors' box.
It looks like Phillips is about to come on for the champions.
Great defending from Toti, who shrugs off Alvarez inside his own area before winning a foul near the corner flag.
City goalscorer Alvarez is booked for kicking the ball away.
HUGE CHANCE! Gomes plays a wonderful ball in behind Ake, who has no chance as Neto bursts past him.
The winger looks to be in on goal, but Akanji gets across with an outstanding recovery challenge.
City make their second change, with Phillips replacing Kovacic in midfield as the visitors prepare to take a corner from the left.
OFF THE LINE! City's corner is cleared, but Bobb keeps it alive with a deep delivery to the far post.
Akanji beats Sa to it and heads towards an unguarded net, but Dawson races back to his line to make a stunning clearance!
GOOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAAAAALLLLLLLLLL! HWANG RESTORES WOLVES' LEAD! Incredible scenes at Molineux as Wolves go 2-1 up! Semedo breaks down the right to cross, with Ake only able to clear as far as Hwang.
His shot is charged down, but it bounces to Cunha, who tees the Korean up to slam into an empty net!
Cunha gets the assist, having shown tremendous composure to tee up Hwang when he could have gone for goal himself.
O'Neil introduces Traore in place of the impressive Gomes, as he looks to add more energy to Wolves' midfield.
Molineux is absolutely bouncing as we approach the final 20 minutes of the 90.
Foden attempts to flick a pass into Bobb's path, but the tireless Lemina is back to make a crucial interception.
Wolves' forward players have gotten through so much defensive work here.
Cunha gets back to win a foul as Phillips goes through the back of the Brazilian, then Hwang recovers possession high on the left to win a throw.

Wolves began this game looking to avoid a third successive Premier League defeat at Molineux in 2023-24, having lost their first three home games of a league campaign on two previous occasions – in 1986-87 and 2021-22.
Can they hold firm to not only avoid defeat, but to clinch a famous win?
There's a brief stoppage as Ait-Nouri goes down, potentially with a bout of cramp.
Wolves will make a change at left wing-back here.
Doherty comes on for Ait-Nouri.
Doku drives to the byline to win a corner for City.
They work an angle for a cross, which Semedo heads away, then Phillips whips a 20-yard effort well wide of the near post.
City work the ball from side to side as they look to prise Wolves' low block open, then Doherty is late on Foden, and the visitors get a free-kick on the right.
Foden lifts the free-kick into the area, but Sa gets off his line to claim it! City are preparing another change here, with Grealish set to enter the fray.
Traore concedes another free-kick, this one in a central position 30 yards from goal.
Foden chips it towards the far post, where Ake sends an awkward header over and wide.
That proves to be Ake's last involvement as Grealish replaces him.
City have less than 10 minutes plus stoppage time to keep their unblemished start to the Premier League campaign going.
Can they tee up a grandstand finish?
Wolves are struggling to get out here, but City's latest attack is halted by the referee as Hwang goes down near the touchline.
Doku tries to roll the Korean off the pitch, and there's some more pushing and shoving as both sets of players get involved.
Doku is booked for his role in the fracas.
Sa is also cautioned, presumably for dissent.
Save! Walker lines up a shot from 25 yards out... but his powerful drive is held by Sa! Haaland was looking to turn it past the Wolves goalkeeper, but he just failed to get a touch at the near post.

events.action: turn it past the Wolves goalkeeper

text: Wolves are preparing two more changes, but they will have to wait as City continue to build patiently.
The hosts can make their changes as Neto wins a throw-in on the right.
Silva replaces Cunha, who has led the line superbly and assisted Hwang's goal.
Hwang gets a standing ovation as he also makes way.
Jonny is on in what is clearly a defensive switch.
Doku has gone over to the right since Grealish came on for City.
He jinks inside before attempting a cute pass into the area, but Sa can smother the loose ball.
Semedo does brilliantly to keep pace with Grealish, who overruns the ball to gift Wolves a goal-kick.
We're about to find out how much stoppage time will be played...
There will be SIX minutes of additional time at Molineux! Can Wolves hold on?
Jonny and Silva combine to get Wolves moving forwards, and the young striker is fouled by Doku, giving the hosts a chance to eat up some valuable seconds.
Silva is booked for delaying a City restart.
Grealish steps inside before offloading to Phillips on the edge of the box... and his left-footed shot deflects behind for a late City corner...
The corner is cleared out to Doku on the far side.
He steps inside before shooting on his left foot... but it deflects into the gloves of Sa!
Kilman and Semedo combine to head a cross clear, then Neto wins a foul off Dias! Wolves are closing in on a huge victory over the champions!
Yellow Card Nélson Cabral Semedo
Yellow Card Jack Peter Grealish
FULL-TIME: WOLVES 2-1 MANCHESTER CITY.

The full-time whistle sounds at Molineux, and Manchester City's perfect start to the Premier League season is over! Wolves hold on for an incredible win over the English and European champions, easing the pressure that was starting to build on O'Neil! Dias' early own goal gave the hosts a lead to defend, but City hit back through Alvarez's stunning free-kick.
Guardiola's men would have fancied their chances of victory from there, but Hwang sparked incredible scenes at Molineux when he powered home from close range, and City couldn't find another leveller.
What a result!
That result lifts Wolves to 13th in the Premier League table with seven points from as many games.
They are four points clear of the relegation zone and face local rivals Aston Villa at Molineux next time out.
City drop points for the first time in 2023-24, meaning Liverpool can leapfrog them at the summit if they beat Tottenham later on Saturday!
We hope you've enjoyed our coverage of a huge upset in the Premier League! It's goodbye for now, and we'll catch you next time!
